blurb: Last year, we paused to reimagine what a contemporary art museum could be. Today, we’re taking the next step. We’re selling our building at 409 West Martin Street. We know that’s a big sentence. So, here’s the honest version of why. The cost of operating a physical space has outpaced the support available to sustain it, a reality facing small-to-midsized museums across the country.
